arStrings.szText:
Casting a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill has a {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0"*100|%|]{/c} chance to summon a {c_important}Conjuration{/c} of the same element.

Each active {c_important}Conjuration{/c} grants:
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_random}[Affix_Value_1*100|1%x|]{/c} increased damage
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} Mana per second
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"*100|%+|]{/c} Movement Speed
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 3"*100|%+|]{/c} Damage Reduction
